current_detections.name: Liquidity Sweep
current_detections.evidence: Price spiked sharply above the prior consolidation range to approximately 585-588 on high volume, taking liquidity above range highs, then reversed aggressively back below 565.

current_detections.name: Bearish Engulfing
current_detections.evidence: A large red candle at the top of the spike engulfed the preceding large green candle, signaling rejection at the local high.

current_detections.name: Bearish Flag
current_detections.evidence: After the vertical spike up (flag pole), price is consolidating in a downward-sloping channel from roughly 580 down toward 560.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Confirmed breakout below flag support around 555-560 to activate the continuation target.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Bullish impulse structure to ~585 has been rejected; price is now forming lower highs and approaching prior support levels.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close below key swing low (~555-560) to fully confirm bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap
tracked_patterns.evidence: The large impulsive green candle from ~555 to ~580 likely left an unfilled fair value gap; current price ~568.77 is trading within or near the gap zone.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price reaction to the gap (fill or rejection); confirmation of the imbalance.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp rally to 585 followed by systematic breakdown of intraday bullish structure, with price approaching key swing low around 565-568.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close below recent swing low (~565) to validate bearish BOS.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp impulsive rally from approximately 555 to 585 followed by an orderly downward drift/consolidation on reduced volume, forming a potential flag channel.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above flag resistance (~578-580) to confirm bullish continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two rejection points visible near the 580-585 area during the spike climax, suggesting potential resistance at the highs.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakdown below the neckline support around 560-565 to confirm the reversal.

tracked_patterns.name: Descending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: After the spike high, price is forming a series of lower highs while testing support near the 560-562 area, suggesting a descending triangle may be forming.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Needs additional touches of the descending trendline and horizontal support, plus a confirmed breakdown below support.

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear price reaction or rejection from the FVG zone to confirm support

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bullish range expansion to sharp bearish rejection after the liquidity sweep, with price collapsing from ~585 toward ~560.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: A clear close below the prior structure low (~550-555) would fully confirm the bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (Bearish)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish impulse to 585 followed by breakdown below prior range structure around 560
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained close below structure and further lower lows to confirm bearish shift
